text: 创业板指、科创50指数均跌超2%，沪指跌0.81%，深成指跌1.68%，算力硬件、军工、消费电子、半导体等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超4400只。
text_en: The ChiNext Index and STAR 50 Index both fell more than 2%, the Shanghai Composite Index fell 0.81%, the Shenzhen Component Index fell 1.68%, with computing hardware, military, consumer electronics, semiconductors and other directions leading declines, and over 4,400 stocks falling across the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets.
